verses.text: Praise the LORD! Singing to our God feels good, and he's worth every bit of praise.
The LORD builds Jerusalem back up. He brings home the people Israel lost to exile.
He heals broken hearts and wraps up their wounds.
He counts every star and calls each one by name.
Our Lord is great, and his power is huge. There's no limit to what he understands.
The LORD holds up the humble and brings the wicked down to the dirt.
Sing to the LORD and thank him. Play the harp and sing to our God,
the one who fills the sky with clouds, gets rain ready for the earth, and makes grass grow on the mountains.
He feeds the livestock and the baby ravens when they cry out.
A horse's strength doesn't impress him. A man's powerful legs don't thrill him either.
The LORD delights in those who honor him with awe, those who put their hope in his faithful love.
Jerusalem, praise the LORD! Zion, praise your God!
He's made the bars on your gates strong and blessed the children who live inside.
He gives you peace all the way to your borders and feeds you with the finest wheat.
He sends his command out across the earth, and his word moves fast.
He lays down snow like wool and sprinkles frost like ashes.
He flings down hail like little stones. Who can stand up to that cold?
Then he gives the word, and it all melts. He sends his wind blowing, and the waters start to flow.
He gives his word to Jacob and makes his laws and rulings known to Israel.
He hasn't done this for any other nation. They don't know his rulings. Praise the LORD!
